# Brand and documentation assets

Use the engine's actual title plus “An InferMatrixLab project” and link to
[InferMatrixLab](https://github.com/InferMatrixLab). The local
[InferMatrix organization logo](infermatrix-logo.png) is copied from the
organization website; keep its original spelling and intact white background.
The InferRSI banner belongs to InferRSI; do not turn it into this engine's logo.

## Included asset provenance

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Local file | `infermatrix-logo.png` |
| Canonical owner/source | InferMatrixLab organization website, `assets/infermatrix-logo.png` |
| Exact source | [Pinned organization asset](https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/infermatrix.github.io/blob/b3903bdaffd4e9550263bf42791995b83f514480/assets/infermatrix-logo.png) |
| Revision | `b3903bdaffd4e9550263bf42791995b83f514480` |
| Use | Organization attribution on an intact light surface, including dark-theme pages |
| License/terms | No separate asset-license grant confirmed in the source; preserve organization ownership/provenance, with no general redistribution claim |
| Update owner/process | Engine maintainer copies a reviewed canonical revision and updates this record; do not edit the logo in place |
| Alt text | InferMatrix organization wordmark |

No dark or transparent variant is included. Add one only when an organization
owner supplies it; keep the engine's text title and attribution readable.

Add approved engine banners, organization logo variants and architecture diagrams
locally only when available. The shared rules live in
[InferRSI branding guidance](https://github.com/InferMatrixLab/InferRSI/blob/main/docs/template/branding.md).
Record every copied asset's canonical source and deliberate update procedure:

```text
Local file: <asset-file>
Purpose / light-or-dark variant: <intended-use>
Canonical repository / path / revision: <approved-source-and-revision>
Copyright / license / reuse permission: <owner-and-terms>
Update owner / procedure: <maintainer-and-reviewed-copy-process>
Alt text: <meaningful-image-description>
```

Do not add a live Markdown image reference until its local file exists. Check
images at mobile/desktop widths and against light/dark backgrounds. Preserve
upstream notices; do not embed unvalidated gain or compatibility claims in art.
